name: SerpApi Amazon Search Workflow
description: Search Amazon through SerpApi, store the normalized listings in Stash, and create a Canvas comparison report.

params.name: serpapi_amazon_${filename_timestamp}.txt

steps.description: Save normalized Amazon results to Stash

steps.llm_prompt:
Create a concise Markdown Amazon shopping report from only the SerpApi data below.

INPUT DATA:
- User task: ${task}
- Original query: ${query_original}
- Effective Amazon query: ${query_used}
- Results count: ${results_count}
- Stash reference: ${stash_ref}
- Top URL: ${serp_result.top_url}
- Top 5 rows: ${serp_result.top_results}

IMPORTANT:
- Use only facts and exact URLs from Top 5 rows and Top URL.
- Never shorten URLs and never output placeholder links like `https://www.amazon.com/...`.
- If a row has no URL, skip that row.
- Treat missing price, rating, Prime, delivery, or stock fields as unknown.
- Use the actual values above; do not output placeholder syntax like ${var}.
- Output raw Markdown only with no code fence or HTML wrapper.

Use this exact structure:
# Amazon Search: ${query_used}

One-line shopping summary.

## Top Amazon Options
- If results_count >= 5, list exactly 5 items.
- If results_count < 5, list all available items and say why fewer exist.
- Each item must include title, one short reason, and a Markdown link using the exact row URL.

## Data
Include original query, effective query, and count.

## References
Include the Stash reference and exact top URL.
steps.description: Create a Canvas Amazon shopping report

success_speech: SerpApi Amazon search complete. I saved the listings to Stash and created a Canvas report with the top options.
abort_speech: I couldn't complete the SerpApi Amazon search workflow.
